param.corpus.assemble.parts: the parts of a text that feed the keywords (by default by the kind of its source: collected texts by title and abstract, documents given whole)
param.corpus.assemble.doc_types: the document types read, for every source without its own list
param.corpus.assemble.provider_priority: which provider's words win when several give the same part, in order
param.corpus.assemble.recency_years: only texts of the last N years build the keywords (0: every year)
param.keywords.extract.counting_unit: what weighs the same when keywords are scored: each person, each text, or each organisation
param.keywords.extract.min_people: a candidate is kept only if at least this many people use it
param.keywords.extract.max_share: a candidate used by more than this share of people is too general
param.keywords.extract.rejects: candidates on cartolex's list of rejections, or that an AI rejected in an earlier project on this computer, are rejected automatically
param.keywords.build.max_keywords: the vocabulary keeps at most this many keywords, the best scored
param.themes.space.dimensions: the dimensions of the space keywords and people are placed in
param.themes.group.depth: the number of theme levels above the keywords
param.themes.group.top_groups: about this many groups at the top level
param.themes.group.keywords_per_group: about this many keywords in each group of the finest level
param.themes.group.level_sizes: the number of groups at each level, from the top; when set, it replaces the three above
param.themes.group.comb: put each keyword on the level its texts support, and set aside the keywords too broad for any theme
param.map.trajectories.window_years: the width of each time window of the trajectories, in years
param.corpus.assemble.duplicate_min_titl: two texts can be one work (read once) only if their titles, without case, accents or punctuation, have at least this many characters
param.corpus.assemble.duplicate_year_gap: two texts with the same title and a common author are one work when their years are at most this far apart
param.keywords.extract.min_texts: a candidate is kept only if it occurs in at least this many distinct texts (a phrase of one co-authored text is one text's evidence)
param.keywords.extract.max_candidates: at most this many candidates per language, the most used, enter the scoring
param.keywords.extract.vote: how a text votes for a candidate it holds: its occurrences (frequency), once (presence) or 1 + ln of its occurrences (sublinear)
param.keywords.extract.length_bonus: a candidate of L words scores 1 + α (L − 1) times more: α, the bonus of each word beyond the first
param.keywords.extract.max_words: the longest candidate, in words (prepositions and articles included)
param.keywords.extract.of_complement: English candidates may take one « of » complement (« rate of change »)
param.keywords.extract.fragment_share: a candidate found this share of its occurrences inside one and the same longer candidate is part of it, set aside (empty: never)
param.keywords.extract.drop_share: the least specific share of the candidates, by score, is set aside (0: none)
param.keywords.extract.keep_share: a phrase is kept only within the best share of the candidates, by score; the others are to check (1: every phrase is kept)
param.keywords.extract.name_share: a candidate found this share of its occurrences inside a name of a person or a place is set aside (when names are known)
param.keywords.extract.stop_words: a single word among the language's stop words, or a closed word of another language, is set aside
param.keywords.extract.closed_word_edges: a phrase that starts or ends with a closed word of another language is set aside (with stop_words on)
param.keywords.extract.foreign_reading: a paragraph whose phrases hold this many different closed words of another language is read as that language: those words break its phrases
param.keywords.extract.even_spread: a single word used by at least this many times the people its occurrences would reach if scattered at random is spread evenly: set aside (empty: never)
param.keywords.extract.even_people: the share of the people with texts in the language a single word must reach before its spread is judged
param.keywords.extract.common_modifier: a phrase whose edge adjective is used by at least this share of people is common: to check (empty: never)
param.keywords.triage.enabled: run the AI clean-up of the candidates (it asks your consent: it sends keyword strings to the AI provider and is billed by it)
param.keywords.build.nested_threshold: a phrase replaces a shorter keyword it contains when it scores at least this many times the shorter one
param.keywords.build.ngram_range: the words of a keyword form counted in the texts, fewest and most (the most grows to the longest form)
param.keywords.build.weights_basis: what a keyword weighs in a person's themes: its share of their words (tf) or its length-boosted TF-IDF (tfidf); ranking and the space use TF-IDF
param.keywords.build.keywords_per_person: each person keeps at most this many keywords, the best scored: the space and the map are made of them
param.keywords.build.keywords_per_organi: each organisation keeps at most this many keywords, the best scored
param.keywords.build.keywords_of_field: the whole field keeps at most this many keywords, the best scored
param.themes.space.space_unit: what the space is fitted on: the people (keywords are near when the same people use them) or the texts (near when the same texts use them)
param.themes.space.svd_seed: the seed of the truncated SVD's random start
param.themes.space.svd_iterations: the power iterations of the randomized SVD: more, closer to the exact one
param.themes.space.svd_algorithm: the SVD's solver: randomized, or arpack (exact, slower)
param.themes.group.cluster_dimensions: the finest groups are cut in this many leading dimensions of the space
param.themes.group.exact_ward_limit: up to this many keywords, Ward's grouping is exact; above, it runs on micro-clusters (its memory grows with the square of this number)
param.themes.group.micro_clusters: the micro-clusters Ward merges above the exact limit (empty: as many as the limit)
param.themes.group.comb_theta: the share of a keyword's use a theme must hold to take it (above what any keyword gives it); empty: calibrated so every level holds about as many keywords per theme
param.themes.group.comb_grid: the θ values the calibration tries
param.themes.group.comb_theta_one_level: θ for a tree of one level, where no balance between levels can choose it
param.themes.group.comb_min_texts: a keyword used in fewer texts keeps its group: too little evidence to move it
param.themes.group.comb_max_cells: above this many keywords × finest groups the proposal is not combed (8 bytes each in memory)
param.themes.group.own_name_floor: a combed theme is named after a keyword of its own only when at least this share of that keyword's use falls in it rather than in its siblings
param.map.layout.neighbours: a keyword, a projected person or a time window is placed from this many nearest mapped people in the space
param.map.layout.link_radius: those neighbours closer than this share of the map's radius form a group; the point goes to the heaviest group
param.map.trajectories.min_texts_per_win: a person's time window is placed only if it holds at least this many texts
